description: Hours: Fulltime, 40 hours Location: Rotterdam, The Netherlands The Position As Supply Chain Business Analyst you develop and synchronise Supply Chain processes and IT systems and manage Supply Chain development projects. You operate at the intersection of Supply Chain business processes, data and IT. Working closely with the business, you understand how processes work, identify opportunities for improvement and translate business needs into practical (improved) processes, models and technology solutions. You act as the bridge between business and IT, understanding the operational context in depth while ensuring requirements can be translated into effective solutions. Your role does not stop at developing a solution. You challenge existing ways of working, make complex solutions practical and user-friendly, and drive stakeholder engagement and adoption. You will join an international team of 4 colleagues, 2 based in The Netherlands and 2 in Sweden. Together with the team and colleagues across the business, you will quickly learn the specifics of our Supply Chain environment while taking ownership of your own projects and stakeholder relationships. Your Key Responsibilities Manage Supply Chain development and optimization projects from business need through implementation; Develop and synchronise Supply Chain processes, models and supporting IT systems, supporting the integration and alignment of our operations since the merger; Analyze processes and data to identify opportunities for optimization, simplification and harmonization; Translate business needs into clear functional and IT requirements, acting as the bridge between Supply Chain and IT; Coordinate projects with Supply Chain Optimization, Execution and Planning teams and VAROPreem IT teams, as well as external consultants and IT partners; Challenge existing ways of working and translate complex requirements into practical and user-friendly solutions; Drive successful implementation by creating stakeholder buy-in and supporting change management; Communicate effectively across the organization, from specialists to team leads and managers. Your Profile A Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, IT or a related field; At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in supply chain business analysis, process improvement, IT development or a similar business–technology environment; Experience within the energy or oil & gas industry is a plus (not a must); Experience working at the intersection of business and IT, with the ability to understand business processes and translate needs into clear functional or technical requirements; Strong analytical skills and an affinity with data, models, technology and Supply Chain processes; A proactive and communicative personality who builds relationships easily, works across different departments and organizational levels, and is comfortable challenging stakeholders and speaking up when needed; A pragmatic mindset with the ability to turn complex challenges into clear, practical and user-friendly solutions, while building support for change and adoption; Professional proficiency in Dutch and English. Our Offer A professional and very well-connected work environment with a young and international team in a growing company, on the cutting edge of the energy transition; Contributing to excellent work delivered by the team, where quality and team spirit are key; Learn from inspiring and exciting areas that intend to change the way the world applies energy; An attractive workplace in the office in Rotterdam with development opportunities within an international, corporate environment; Attractive salary structures, as well as a (partly) employer-financed pension and bike plan etc.; Fun and supportive team environment that welcomes you to several social events. Are you ready to take this exciting journey with us? Then we look forward to receiving your application – simply click on the “Apply now” button to get started. description: Syntrace builds conversational knowledge for institutional investors. We capture, organize and synthesize private conversations into source-backed knowledge a firm can build on. We are now hiring a Data Analyst, based in Berlin. You will turn our data into decisions. You will analyze how customers use the product, measure the quality of what our AI delivers and give product, sales and leadership the insights they need. Our users trust us with the most sensitive conversations they have. That makes security part of the product, not a feature on top of it. What you bring: - A few years of experience in data analysis, or a strong academic background in a quantitative field. - Strong SQL, and experience with Python or a similar language for analysis. - The ability to turn a vague question into a clear answer. What you get: - A founding role with real ownership. - A senior team that has scaled companies before. - The chance to shape how a company understands itself. To apply, send a short note to careers@syntrace.com about yourself. If you know someone who should read this, send it to them.

description: Job Summary: We are seeking a mid-level Business Analyst to join our Technology/IT team in Den Haag. In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions, driving process improvements and delivering data-driven insights. You will collaborate with stakeholders across departments to define requirements, analyze business processes, and support strategic decision-making. Responsibilities: Gather, document, and analyze business requirements from stakeholders Translate business needs into functional specifications and user stories Conduct data analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities Facilitate workshops and meetings to elicit requirements and validate solutions Collaborate with IT and development teams to ensure solutions meet business objectives Support project management activities, including planning, tracking, and reporting Develop and maintain process documentation, including flowcharts and use cases Assist in user acceptance testing and change management activities Requirements: Required Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, or BI tools) Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Experience with requirements gathering and process mapping Preferred Experience in the technology or IT sector Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies Certification such as CBAP or PMI-PBA Experience with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) What We Offer: Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses Health and wellness benefits, including medical and dental coverage Professional development opportunities and training budget Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options Generous paid time off and holiday leave Collaborative and inclusive team culture
